name: Distribution centre DC-2 (warehouse and logistics)
description: Ambient pick zone B at a grocery distribution centre: a pick face below minimum, a delayed inbound rice shipment, an oil count mismatch and a cold room creeping up. All data synthetic.

metadata.serves: Grocery store replenishment, two pick waves per shift
safety_notes: Pedestrians stop at aisle ends and make eye contact with the forklift driver before crossing; never stand under a raised load (SOP section 5.1).
Never climb racking; above level 2 use the order picker with a harness (SOP section 5.2).

limits.label: cold room temperature
limits.note: Keep chilled stock between 2 and 8 C.
limits.action_high: Above 8 C for 15 minutes: move chilled stock to the backup cold room and call facilities.

training.title: DC-2 forklift and working-at-height safety
training.intro: Three questions on forklifts, raised loads and reaching high locations.

questions.ask: A forklift is coming as you reach the end of an aisle. What do you do before crossing?
questions.explain: Stop at the aisle end and make eye contact with the driver before you cross; forklifts give way to pedestrians only in marked walkways.

questions.ask: Can you walk under a raised load if you are quick?
questions.explain: Never stand or walk under a raised load, however quick.

questions.ask: You need a case from level 3. How do you reach it?
questions.explain: Never climb racking. Above level 2 use the order picker with your harness clipped to the anchor point.
